mapper.select: SELECT id, vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_count, illness_count, injury_count, evacuation_count, sick_leave_days, pos_sm_synced_at, excel_upload_id, uploaded_by, comment, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_safety_performance_sea WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT sp.id, sp.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, sp.period_year, sp.period_month, sp.crew_count, sp.illness_count, sp.injury_count, sp.evacuation_count, sp.sick_leave_days, sp.pos_sm_synced_at, sp.excel_upload_id, sp.uploaded_by, ru.name AS uploader_name, sp.comment, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at FROM tb_safety_performance_sea sp LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = sp.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = sp.uploaded_by AND ru.deleted = 0
ORDER BY sp.period_year DESC, sp.period_month DESC, sp.vessel_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_performance_sea ( vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_count, illness_count, injury_count, evacuation_count, sick_leave_days, pos_sm_synced_at, excel_upload_id, uploaded_by, comment, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{vesselId}, #{periodYear}, #{periodMonth}, #{crewCount}, #{illnessCount}, #{injuryCount}, #{evacuationCount}, #{sickLeaveDays}, #{posSmSyncedAt}, #{excelUploadId}, #{uploadedBy}, #{comment}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_safety_performance_sea SET crew_count = #{crewCount}, illness_count = #{illnessCount}, injury_count = #{injuryCount}, evacuation_count = #{evacuationCount}, sick_leave_days = #{sickLeaveDays}, pos_sm_synced_at = COALESCE(#{posSmSyncedAt}, pos_sm_synced_at), excel_upload_id = COALESCE(#{excelUploadId}, excel_upload_id), uploaded_by = #{uploadedBy}, comment = #{comment}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_safety_performance_sea ( vessel_id, period_year, period_month, crew_count, illness_count, injury_count, evacuation_count, sick_leave_days, excel_upload_id, uploaded_by, comment, created_at, deleted ) VALUES
( #{it.vesselId}, #{it.periodYear}, #{it.periodMonth}, #{it.crewCount}, #{it.illnessCount}, #{it.injuryCount}, #{it.evacuationCount}, #{it.sickLeaveDays}, #{it.excelUploadId}, #{it.uploadedBy}, #{it.comment}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_safety_performance_sea SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
